verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a hands-on production user who credits Angular with AOT compilation and tree-shaking, which shrink client bundles. First-party docs only say Angular is a 'fully featured platform' with first-party modules and is 'fast', and say nothing about bundle size or dependency footprint. missing for 10: first-party documentation of bundle-size optimization (AOT, tree-shaking, budgets), evidence of a small runtime footprint or minimal dependency tree, any supply-chain-risk reduction claims, recent independent corroboration
